label: side_collision
summary: A vehicle in the adjacent lane was traveling close to Ego, then abruptly cut into Ego's lane with a very small gap. A collision occurred.
observations: Adjacent vehicle was initially in a neighboring lane.
Vehicle performed abrupt lane intrusion ahead of Ego.
event_explanation: Unsafe cut-in reduced longitudinal clearance below a safe following distance.

hypothesis.text: Primary cause: unsafe lane change with insufficient gap.
